title: Isolation of genetically manipulated neural progenitors and immature neurons from embryonic mouse neocortex by FACS
protocol: Add DMEM/F12 containing 1% PS to a glass dish cooled with ice.
Dissect the neocortex from embryos placed in the glass dish.
Isolate the region of interest using a stereomicroscope.
Transfer the neocortex into a 1.5-mL tube.
Leave the tube briefly to allow the neocortex to sediment and discard the medium.
Add an appropriate volume of Enzyme Solution from Neuron Dissociation Solutions.
Incubate for 20 minutes in a heat block at 37°C.
Mix with a pipette (~20 times) attached to a P200 or P1000 Pipetman (Gilson).
Centrifuge at 600 × g for 2 minutes at room temperature (18°C–24°C).
Discard the supernatant, add Dispersion Solution to the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet with the use of a pipette and add Isolation Solution below the Dispersion Solution.
Centrifuge at 600 × g for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant, add 200 μl of 0.2% BSA/PBS to the pellet.
Resuspend with a pipette.
Layer cell suspension on top of Percoll solution.
Centrifuge at 600 × g for 2 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant, add 200 μl of 0.2% BSA/PBS to the pellet, and resuspend with a pipette.
Add fluorescent label-conjugated antibodies at a 1:400 dilution.
Incubate for 10 min at 4°C.
Centrifuge at 600 × g for 2 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant, add 300 μl of 0.2% BSA/PBS to the pellet for washing.
Centrifuge at 600 × g for 2 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant, add an appropriate volume of 0.2% BSA/PBS to the pellet, and resuspend with a pipette.
Filter and transfer the suspension using 5 mL Round Bottom Polystyrene Test Tube with Cell Strainer Snap Cap.
Run control samples including non-stained and single-stained samples in order to check for potential spectral overlap.
Set up compensation if necessary.
Run fully stained samples and set gates.
Remove debris according to the plot of forward scatter (FSC)–A and side scatter (SSC)–A.
Remove doublets according to plots of FSC-W and FSC-H and of SSC-W and SSC-H.
Separate GFP-positive (GFPpos) and GFP-negative (GFPneg) populations on the basis of FITC-A signals.
Determine cell populations such as CD133high cells using APC-A signals with the use of GFPneg cells.
Apply gates determined with the GFPneg population to the GFPpos population.
Prepare 1.5-mL collection tubes.
Coat the inner wall of 1.5-mL tubes with 500 μl of 1% BSA/PBS.
Add 500 μl of 0.2% BSA/PBS to the coated 1.5-mL tubes as a cushion.
Sort the populations of interest into the prepared 1.5-mL tubes.
Invert and mix each tube immediately after sorting.
Centrifuge at 600 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Freeze the cell pellet with liquid N2 and store at -80°C.
Store the cell pellets at -80°C for more than 1 year.
Centrifuge cells.
Wash cell pellets with PBS.
Store cell pellets at -80°C.
Proceed to the ATAC reaction without freezing cells for ATAC-seq.
Cryopreserve cell pellet using a cell stock solution like CELLBANKER for CUT&Tag.
Sort cells directly into 1.5 mL tube including cell stock solution.
Extract total RNA from frozen cells with RNAiso Plus.
Measure RNA concentration with an absorption photometer such as NanoDrop.
Subject the total RNA to RT with ReverTra Ace qPCR RT Master Mix.
Dilute generated cDNA 5- to 10-fold with water.
Prepare the qPCR premix according to the protocol.
Add 3 μl of the premix followed by 2 μl of diluted cDNA to an 8-stripe tube or a 96-well plate.
Mix and centrifuge briefly the samples added to the tubes or well plates.
Perform the qPCR reaction in a LightCycler 480 instrument according to the manufacturer's protocol for SYBR reagent.
